item: Two data layers still instruct a reader to stage an emigrant transfer over two years, which 汇发〔2014〕2号 cancelled
detail: data/cost_steps.csv rows 20-22 (method M03, steps 5-7) read 'Take tranche 1 — up to half', 'Take tranche 2 — up to half the remainder, after 1 year' and 'Take tranche 3 — the balance, after 2 years … Total elapsed time from first payment: two years'. data/d646_methods.csv row 6 (M05) states 'Staged: first half, then half of remainder after 1 year, rest after 2 years' and 'Yes, but staged over 2+ years'. Neither file contains the string 2014 or 汇发〔2014〕2号 anywhere (grep count 0 in both).
why_blank_or_wrong: 汇发〔2014〕2号 §6(2) cancels the staged remittance: 银行可在核准件审批额度内一次或分次汇出相关资金. §6(1) also cancels the RMB 500,000 head-office filing. A reader following those rows would wait two years for money that can lawfully be remitted in one lump. (data/reference_inputs.csv R30, data/cost_inputs.csv CI29 and data/verify_2026.csv V08 record the same 2004 text, but those files do also carry the 2014 cancellation elsewhere, so they are lower risk.)
how_to_close: The owning sessions should correct or mark those rows superseded. This session did not edit their files; the request is logged in COORDINATION.md. The n676 pages state the 2014 position only, and quote both the 2004 text and the 2014 cancellation side by side in the source register so the supersession is visible.

item: Nine different headline totals for the same two transfers are live at once, with no superseded banner and no board stamp on most pages
detail: Counted across the 98 published HTML files on this tree: the $10,000 wire appears as $53.38 (36 files), $53.42 (35), $53.45 (10), $53.47 (7) and $50.93 (2); the $400,000 wire appears as $901.30 (17), $901.20 (11), $901.81 (1) and $901.09 (1).
why_blank_or_wrong: Each figure is arithmetically correct for the intraday BOC board snapshot its layer was priced from. The defect is that a reader landing on any one page has no way to tell which snapshot it used or that a newer one exists. This is a presentation defect, not an arithmetic one.
how_to_close: Every cost page should carry the board stamp it was priced from in its heading, and older layers should carry a superseded banner. The n676 pages carry the stamp. A cross-layer banner is a shared-file change, so it is logged as a request in COORDINATION.md rather than made here.

item: The USD 50,000 figure is used for two unrelated rules across the tree
detail: One is the individual annual convenience amount (汇发〔2020〕14号 art. 55, ID-only purchases, card holders only). The other is the institutional profit-remittance document-review threshold in 汇发〔2014〕2号 §5(1), which applies to companies.
why_blank_or_wrong: Conflating them leads to the belief that a U.S. individual may remit USD 50,000 a year on ID alone, which art. 59 does not permit without a Foreign Permanent Resident ID.
how_to_close: Keep the two labelled distinctly on every page. The n676 methods table separates them (M03 vs M09).
